subject: Purchase authorization and billing rhythm exceptions
messages:
From: Dana Brooks <dana.brooks@lumentech.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@lumentech.com>, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Purchase window & PO format — quick clarification

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the call this morning. We’re close to internal approval but Procurement asked for two clarifications before they can issue the PO: 1) they need Redwood to accept our standard PO header (I attached the Po_template we use across vendors), and 2) they want invoices on a monthly cadence with a consolidated statement at month-end rather than individual invoice per deployment.

Also — our finance team requested Net45 instead of Net30 and would like a 3% volume discount if our annual committed spend hits $1.2M. Are those OK for Redwood to accommodate?

I attached the PO template for reference. Happy to hop on a short call if it helps speed approval.

Thanks,
Dana Brooks
Sr. Procurement Manager
LumenTech

Attachments: LumenTech_PO_template.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Brooks <dana.brooks@lumentech.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Purchase window & PO format — quick clarification

Dana —

Appreciate the detail and the template. Fast answers below:

- PO header: we can accept your PO header but request a single PO number per legal entity (our billing pipeline requires a PO ID to attach to the invoice). If your template allows a "PO Number" field we’re good; otherwise, we can add a short mapping step on our side.

- Invoice cadence: monthly consolidated invoices + month-end statement are fine. We’ll mark billing to deliver one statement per calendar month with line-item breakdown for usage.

- Net terms: Net45 is outside our standard Net30 policy but we can agree to Net45 for the first 12 months on the committed contract with standard credit checks (and a PO deposit if needed).

- Volume discount: we can offer a 3% discount at $1.2M ARR equivalent for committed usage, but the discount requires an advance-commit clause (to ensure predictability) and will apply to consumed tokens once the threshold is met.

I’ve looped in Vanessa (partnerships) and Karthik (billing) to confirm implementation details. Can we target a signature this week if Procurement can issue the PO with the PO number field filled?

Best,
Vivek
VP, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-pricing-offer-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 45KB)

--

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Purchase window & PO format — quick clarification

All — quick notes from my side after reviewing LumenTech's template and the pricing sheet: 

1) PO header: their template has multiple entity fields. We should accept it but require a single canonical PO number. If their PO supplies multiple PO lines for different cost centers we’ll accept those as long as a single header PO number maps to the invoice. Karthik, can engineering/billing accept multi-line PO mapping to one invoice?

2) Net45 + deposit: acceptable as a temporary concession. Suggest we ask for a 10% prepayment to mitigate extended terms for the first billing cycle (refund against the first month). That reduces credit risk and keeps cash coverage. Dana — would Procurement accept a 10% deposit?

3) Discount structure: rather than a hard 3% at the $1.2M mark, propose a tiered approach: 1.5% at $600k, 3% at $1.2M, with lookback true-up at year-end. That gives them near-term benefit and protects our margin.

4) Invoice cadence: agree to monthly consolidated statements. Need to ensure we can attach usage detail per customer project — Kimberly can confirm export format.

Happy to take a short call with Dana to finalize.

Thanks,
Vanessa
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Purchase window & PO format — quick clarification

Vanessa / team —

We can map multiple cost-center lines in the PO to a single invoice as long as Procurement provides a single PO number in the header. Our billing export already supports per-line metadata (cost center, project id) and a consolidated invoice. Two operational asks:

1) We’ll need the PO number populated before the first invoice run (cutoff is the 1st of the month). If the PO arrives after the cutoff we can still back-apply to next invoice but that complicates month-end reconciliations.

2) If LumenTech requests Net45 + deposit, we can accept the deposit as a credit balance applied to invoices; finance will mark account as Net45 with the credit applied. We do recommend a one-time 10% prepay if they insist on Net45 for first 6 months.

I’ve attached a brief checklist for Procurement to speed onboarding.

—Karthik
Billing Ops Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment: billing-onboard-checklist.txt (text, 4KB)

Thanks Vivek / Vanessa / Karthik —

This is helpful. Two quick items from Procurement/Finance:

• Procurement can populate a single PO number in the header — that’s our standard. We can include cost center lines under the same PO.

• Finance needs confirmation in writing that the 10% prepayment will be treated as a credit and applied to the first invoice; Marco (cc’d) will sign off if that is the approach.

We’ll prepare the PO with the PO number and send it over by tomorrow EOD. Please confirm the deposit instruction and we’ll route the payment.

Dana
Sr. Procurement Manager | LumenTech

Dana / Marco —

Confirmed: Redwood will treat the 10% prepayment as a credit on the account and will apply it to the first issued invoice. Finance will flag the account as Net45 for the first 12 months (after which we’ll revert to Net30 unless otherwise agreed). The tiered discount is acceptable per the terms Vanessa described (1.5% at $600k, 3% at $1.2M with year-end true-up).

Operational notes: please ensure the PO includes the PO Number in the header (we match on that). Once we receive the PO we’ll create the billing account and send a payment link for the 10% deposit (ACH and wire accepted).

Vivek
VP, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
